ranked.headline: Diffusion and agentic search steer biomolecular sequences toward multiple objectives
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair discrete diffusion and reinforcement fine-tuning with explicit multi-objective and directional control for protein and binder design.

ranked.headline: Agentic AI converts biomedical literature and omics data into computable resources
ranked.summary: Agent pipelines now extract, harmonize, and simulate biomedical evidence from papers and assays, with human oversight built in.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic architecture in microbial and slime mold models dictates distinct outcomes
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now tie specific architectural features to particular outcome criteria across microbial and slime mold systems.

ranked.headline: Graph models extend to local and sample-level inference in omics and spatial data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial datasets now demand graph methods that infer local, sample-specific structure with explicit error control or perturbation machinery.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell fate and state dynamics from time-resolved single-cell measurements
ranked.summary: Live imaging, splicing kinetics and morphology now feed dynamical models that infer cell fate from single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Automated analysis pipelines for high-dimensional single-cell and imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair automated preprocessing, segmentation, and reusable benchmarks with open-source tools for high-dimensional omics and imaging data.

ranked.headline: ML infers tumor immune and spatial molecular states from imaging and omics data
ranked.summary: Histology, MRI and multi-omics models now predict molecular tumor states, with outputs framed as candidate biomarkers validated on held-out cohorts.

ranked.headline: Public benchmarks test whether molecular predictors capture genuine biology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers release curated benchmarks spanning DNA-encoded libraries, CRISPR screens, protein function, and protein-ligand complexes.

ranked.headline: Model structure limits what time series and single-cell data can identify about dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent work shows that identifiability and estimator bias, not trajectory data alone, bound what biological dynamics models can reveal.

ranked.headline: LLM agents coupled to knowledge graphs and evidence retrieval for biomedical discovery
ranked.summary: Preprints now benchmark agentic reproducibility and ground LLM reasoning in structured knowledge and multimodal patient data.

ranked.headline: Generative and enhanced-sampling models recover biomolecular conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study show that the inference or sampling layer materially shapes recovered biomolecular conformational estimates.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks reveal metric inflation and pipeline-dependent performance in omics analysis
ranked.summary: Shared control reuse and pipeline choice are inflating or destabilizing omics performance estimates, motivating standardized benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Methods correct RNA-seq scale bias and model longitudinal single-cell dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add tools for correcting RNA-seq scale distortion and modeling longitudinal single-cell dynamics without curated priors.

ranked.headline: Microbial genomics pipelines are judged on accuracy, contamination, and sequencing depth
ranked.summary: Tool choice materially alters resulting profiles, so control-free and quantitative quality checks are becoming embedded in analysis workflows.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict peptide recognition by TCRs, HLA and NK receptors
ranked.summary: Protein language models and sequence-based transformers now extend from binding prediction to generative design and quantitative presentation.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks add biological priors to protein, drug, and receptor prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers embed biological priors into graph models for PPI, drug-target, drug synergy, and olfactory receptor prediction.

ranked.headline: Three-dimensional structure constrains protein sequence models for design and function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply 3D structural contacts and graph representations to sequence-level design and variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Physics-based residue descriptors and membrane simulations inform peptide design
ranked.summary: Quantum residue descriptors, interpretable energy functions, and membrane free-energy workflows now appear together in recent work.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links sequence and language embeddings to regulatory and functional sites
ranked.summary: Fine-tuned genomic and protein language models are now applied directly to binding, modification, and variant-impact prediction from sequence and assay data.

ranked.headline: Mapping regulatory variants and cis-elements across chromatin and transcription assays
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, and colocalisation methods are exposing technical bias and interpretive limits in regulatory variant studies.

ranked.headline: Generative models add uncertainty and shared latent structure to biological imaging
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply pretrained foundation models and aligned normalizing flows to 3D restoration and multiview biological imaging.

ranked.headline: MD trajectory analysis resolves allosteric and RNA recognition mechanisms in proteins
ranked.summary: Trajectory-level MD and Markov state analyses now yield mechanistic readouts of allostery and RNA-disordered region recognition.

ranked.headline: Long-read RNA and phasing methods validated against reference and orthogonal truth
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test long-read haplotype phasing, RNA modification calling, and isoform and readthrough inference against reference or orthogonal data.

ranked.headline: Network topology and null models shape omic gene prioritisation and biomarker discovery
ranked.summary: Graph-based and null-controlled methods are being used to prioritise genes and biomarkers from omic and network data.

ranked.headline: In silico reverse vaccinology targets conserved Mycobacterium epitopes across strains
ranked.summary: Genome-scale strain panels now feed computational vaccine design for tuberculosis, though all evidence remains in silico.

ranked.headline: Parameterized shape models couple morphology to flow and tissue mechanics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints recast boundary, dorsal, and tissue shapes as tunable parameters tied to hydrodynamic or target-morphology outcomes.

ranked.headline: Computational tools resolve isomiR variants for target and source inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply deep learning, probabilistic denoising, and EV profiling to isomiR-level data, extending miRNA analysis beyond canonical sequences.

ranked.headline: Noise shapes division control and derivative-action circuits in biomolecular systems
ranked.summary: Stochastic models now resolve how intrinsic and extrinsic noise shape cell-size control and biomolecular signal differentiation.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and reconstruction tools for long-read and bacterial genome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and tools test how faithfully simulators reproduce Nanopore reads and how bacterial haplotypes and associations can be resolved from…

ranked.headline: Compiler-verified and formal languages for executable laboratory protocols
ranked.summary: Machine-checkable protocol languages aim to validate LLM-generated lab procedures before they are executed on physical or automated systems.

ranked.headline: Molecular noise and measurement uncertainty as explicit inputs to biological modeling
ranked.summary: Stochastic transcription, circuit design, and ODE inference preprints now embed noise and measurement uncertainty directly within the modeling pipeline.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer structure and function from sparse or noisy structural data
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and sparse experimental parameters now feed probabilistic and learned models for RNA conformation, protein function, and phylogenetics.

ranked.headline: Software tools packaging omics and biochemical network analysis for reproducibility
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a PLOS Computational Biology paper address dependency handling, scalability, and reproducibility of bioinformatics software.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneous contact, behavior, and mobility reshape epidemic model inference
ranked.summary: Recent studies show that unobserved contact structure, adaptive behavior, and travel alter inferred transmission parameters and outbreak timing.

ranked.headline: Homeostatic feedback models test adaptive regulation in metabolism and brain dynamics
ranked.summary: Three May 2026 reports couple homeostatic feedback to energy metabolism and whole-brain neural dynamics, with one Parkinson's transcriptomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Open-source software bridging mass spectrometry output and biological interpretation
ranked.summary: Five recent tools automate QC, protein corona analysis, variant tracking, and PTM visualization for reproducible omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link multiomic data to regulatory and drug-response inference
ranked.summary: Newer statistical and neural frameworks quantify cross-modal confidence and perturbation effects directly from heterogeneous omics data.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and differentiable models bring kinetic inference to metabolic networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple inference, ensemble sampling, and hybrid dynamics to constrain metabolic models against bulk and clinical data.

ranked.headline: Software for inspecting protein interactions, biosynthetic loci, and pangenome graphs
ranked.summary: Four preprints posted 7–10 May 2026 release reusable browser- or CLI-based tools for inspecting predicted protein, genome-mining, and pangenome outputs.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell history and DNA content from indirect sequencing measurements
ranked.summary: Three new preprints model methylation, fragment overlaps, and barcode data to recover unobserved cell histories and genomic states.
